evals.prompt:
boil this down for me, it's way too long for a PR description:

[paste content of evals/files/rate-limiting-spec.md]
evals.expected_output: A tight technical brief (~150-200 words) that preserves the Redis ZSET implementation detail, specific rate limits (100/min, 10/min writes, 20/15min unauth), Lua script atomicity, response header names, and config file location. Drops the algorithm survey (fixed window, sliding log, token bucket comparisons) to a single line at most.
assertions: The brief mentions Redis ZSETs or the specific Redis data structure
The brief preserves all three specific numeric limits (100/min, 10/min for writes, 20 requests per 15 min unauthenticated)
The brief does not contain multi-sentence descriptions of fixed window counter, sliding log, and token bucket algorithms
The brief mentions the Lua script or atomic check-and-increment
The brief mentions the rate limit response headers (RateLimit-Limit or X-RateLimit-Limit)
The output is significantly shorter than the original (under 350 words)
